summary: Verified Electron clipboard bug fix (Copy-to-Clipboard for snip/screenshot). Code integrity, packaging integrity, and web preview regression all pass.

verifications.preload_source: /app/desktop/preload.js imports { clipboard, nativeImage } from electron and exposes copyImageToClipboard(dataUrl) -> clipboard.writeImage(nativeImage.createFromDataURL(dataUrl)) and copyTextToClipboard(text) -> clipboard.writeText. Confirmed at lines 1, 14-23, 26-33.
verifications.manuscript_ruler_source: ManuscriptRuler.jsx line 1022-1023 _safeCopyText prefers window.msElectron.copyTextToClipboard; line 1533-1534 copySnipToClipboard prefers window.msElectron.copyImageToClipboard before falling back to navigator.clipboard.write(ClipboardItem).
verifications.zip_integrity: Downloaded /api/download/windows (114MB). resources/app.asar present (9.3MB). Extracted via `npx asar extract`. /tmp/asar_ext/preload.js contains 'copyImageToClipboard' (1 match) and 'clipboard.writeImage' (1 match). Compiled main.3362c827.js contains 'copyImageToClipboard' (1 match) — proves both preload and frontend bundle include the fix.
verifications.web_preview_regression: Loaded https://script-guide-8.preview.emergentagent.com/#ns=A — splash page renders correctly with brand logo, title 'مُتَصَفِّحُ المخْطُوطاتِ', toolbar (فتح مخطوط, البطاقة, تصفح, ترقيم, مقابلة, تعليق, تصدير, لقطة) all visible. 0 console errors.

critical_code_review_comments: Preload correctly guards against empty nativeImage (isEmpty check) — good.

Note: Actual runtime verification of the copy on Windows requires running the packaged .exe which is not possible on this Linux/aarch64 sandbox. The fix relies on Electron's well-documented native clipboard API which works on file:// origins.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 6 verified the Electron clipboard fix at code + package + web-regression level. The Windows exe cannot be executed on this environment, so runtime clipboard behavior on Windows is unverified but relies on standard Electron clipboard API.
